selection: Every tracked SKILL.md directory present at both exact heads in each of the three independently selected public repositories. No substitute pairs. All changed directories: parse only explicit name and version if present. No execution of third-party code. Git API tree object IDs are evidence of tracked Git state, not SHA256 content verification, installed bytes, publisher authenticity or signature verification.
acceptance: Each exact tree is nontruncated and Git ref is pinned; otherwise arm blocked.
For each common directory compare Git directory-tree identity and separately ordered tracked leaf path/mode/type/blob identities. Disagreement fails the engineering claim.

For changed trees report identical explicit name/version cases separately from missing/invalid metadata. A versionless logical identifier collision is a counterexample to use of that identifier alone for exact source state, not a rejection of proposed version-bearing PURLs.
Compare competent conventional repo+commit+path and repo+directory-tree ID; no advantage if they suffice. No economic qualification without observed paid demand and costed superior complete route.
stopping: One evaluation per fixed pair; no extra revisions to improve result. Preserve every blocked/failed pair.
arrangements: Agent-skill component identity, source-change invalidation, and future provenance linkage (public PURL issue #867; CodeSupply second call; conventional Git + SLSA/in-toto).
Maven inherited license metadata (PurlDB open issue; complete ScanCode/metadata route already under development; do not duplicate).
Public grant-funded open infrastructure (Sovereign Tech Fund >EUR50k, excludes prototypes; existing adoption not established).
cost_scope: No native account, no spend or contracts, no host/model billing measurement. Only repository metadata and public frontmatter; no private installation data.
